auth_signInTitle: Sign in with your Apple ID
auth_signInHint: Sign in with an email or phone number to use RenVault
auth_privacyNotice: We use your Apple ID to securely sign you in and access your data. Apple may collect information for security purposes. Learn more in the
auth_2faHint: A verification code has been sent to your trusted devices. Enter the code to continue.
auth_deviceSelectionHint: Select a trusted device to continue. You'll be asked to enter its passcode to verify your identity.
auth_devicePasscodeHint: Enter the passcode you use to unlock “{device}”. Your passcode is never sent to Apple.
auth_masterSetupHint: This password encrypts your vault on this device. It is never sent anywhere and cannot be recovered, if you forget it, you will have to sign in again.
auth_unlockHint: Enter your master password to decrypt your vault.
passkey_noteDesc: A passkey is a secure way to sign in to your accounts. Passkeys provide more security than traditional passwords.
failure_generic: Something went wrong. Please check your connection and try again.
failure_badCredentials: Your Apple Account or password is incorrect.
failure_accountLocked: This account has been locked for security reasons.
failure_wrongPasscode: That passcode is incorrect. Apple limits how many times you can try.
zone_all_desc: Passwords are securely stored for your websites and apps. Access your saved credentials anytime.
zone_passkeys_desc: Passkeys provide the strongest security available for your accounts. When using a passkey, authenticate with your device's biometrics, PIN, or passcode to sign in.
zone_codes_desc: Verification codes provide an extra layer of security to help keep your accounts safe.
zone_networks_desc: Wi-Fi networks are securely stored for quick access. View and manage your saved networks.
zone_security_desc: RenVault privately and securely monitors your passwords to alert you if any are easily guessed or appear in data leaks from website.
zone_deleted_desc: Deleted items stay here for 30 days before they are removed for good. Recover the ones you still need.
